name: Assassin’s Venom [Psionic]
body:
The poisons you create are more effective.

Prerequisite: base attack bonus +3, Assassin warrior path, prevenom or prevenom weapon path power.

Benefit: You gain a bonus on the save DC of prevenom
and prevenom weapon equal to the competence bonus
granted by your trance class feature
